prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Thalara Rootwright. Character visual motifs: elderly fungus architect with ceramic seed jars, branching mycelium sleeves and mushroom-coral parasol; no tree-ring prison.
TOP LEFT: Spores in Soil. Ability concept: ability hits leave a nutrient node for 6 s (max 4). Nodes are visible small mushrooms with 2 hit points.
TOP RIGHT: Root Survey. Ability concept: grows a narrow mycelial line between Thalara and one node. Allies moving along it gain minor speed; enemies crossing it suffer an initial short slow. One line per node.
BOTTOM LEFT: Transplant. Ability concept: moves a single active nutrient node up to 60 GU with 0.5 s tell; enemies standing on the displaced line are gently redirected to nearest free space, no stun.
BOTTOM RIGHT: The Living Understory. Ability concept: activates the node network for 5 s: allies touching a connected line regenerate modest HP over time; enemy AoE detonations on the web burn one node but trigger a one-time small burst. Opponents can cut the network one node at a time.
